$comment: The connectors of this domain (ADR layer 5): agents ask for a system by name; the standard that carries it is a fact of the domain, not of the code. Shown in the rulebook. Every entry is a real standard or product class; the organisations are fictional.

connectors.name: Versicherer
connectors.carries: Gutachtenauftrag, Gutachten (eGutachten), Nachtrag, Rückfragen, Honorarrechnung, Restwertanfragen
connectors.note: Der GDV-Datensatz läuft seit 1999 produktiv; über 110 Versicherer und 100 Dienstleister sind angeschlossen.
connectors.carries_en: Assessment order, assessment (e-assessment), supplement, questions, fee invoice, residual value requests
connectors.note_en: The GDV data set has been in production since 1999; more than 110 insurers and 100 service providers are connected.

connectors.name: Makler und Vermittler
connectors.note: Eine eigene BiPRO-Norm Kfz-Schaden ist in der Normierung (RNext).
connectors.carries_en: Claim status, documents on the claim
connectors.note_en: A BiPRO standard of its own for motor claims is being drafted (RNext).

connectors.name: Kalkulation
connectors.note: Die Kalkulation bleibt im Werkzeug des Gutachters; die Akte trägt das Ergebnis als Anlage.
connectors.carries_en: Vehicle identification (VIN), spare parts, labour, paint, repair time
connectors.note_en: The calculation stays in the assessor's tool; the file carries the result as an attachment.

connectors.name: Restwertbörse
connectors.carries: drei Restwertangebote vom regionalen Markt bei Totalschaden
connectors.carries_en: Three residual value offers from the regional market for a total loss

connectors.name: Vorschadenhinweise
connectors.carries: Hinweise zu Vorschäden, kommen mit dem Auftrag des Versicherers
connectors.note: Die Abfrage macht der Versicherer, nicht der Gutachter.
connectors.carries_en: Hints on previous damage, come with the insurer's order
connectors.note_en: The insurer runs the query, not the assessor.

connectors.name: Disposition
connectors.carries: Termine, Touren, Besichtigungsart (vor Ort, Werkstatt, remote)
connectors.carries_en: Appointments, routes, kind of inspection (on site, workshop, remote)

connectors.name: Dokumente
connectors.carries: Fotos, Gutachten in Fassungen, Anschreiben, Belege
connectors.carries_en: Photos, assessment in versions, cover letters, receipts

connectors.name: Postausgang
connectors.carries: Versand des freigegebenen Gutachtens, nur nach Freigabe
connectors.carries_en: Sending the approved assessment, only after approval

$comment_en: Every field has an English twin (<field>_en) for the English surface; the German stays the original.
